title: About Me
text:
I’m a robotics researcher and engineer, currently at the Boston Dynamics AI Institute where we’re trying to make robots learn to do stuff by watching and understanding humans. Previously, I spent time at Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute where I made robots move around while looking at the right things around them. And eons ago, I studied electrical systems and computer science at the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani.
In this corner of the interwebs, you shall find: less fun versions of the above (bio, resume, CV), my research, my writing, and my contact information.
